audit.classification_rule: SUPPORTIVE: all 3 models reduce worst MDD and retain >=50% absolute average-return magnitude; NOT_SUPPORTIVE: no model reduces worst MDD, or fewer than 2 improve while all retain <50%; otherwise MIXED.
audit.interpretation: 最差 MDD 在 3/3 個模型降低；1% 風險預算與 40% Exposure 上限為事前固定，報酬與風險變化須一併解讀。
